segments.he: מַהוּ דְּתֵימָא: רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ לְשֶׁעָבַר הָוֵי, וְלָא לִיתְּסַר, קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן קָרוּ אִינָשֵׁי רֵישׁ יַרְחָא.
segments.en: This is «lest you say» that the first day of «the New Moon is» part «of the previous» month, «and» therefore the vow should expire at the end of that day, «and» wine «should not be forbidden» to him during the upcoming month. The tanna therefore «teaches us» that since «people call it the New Moon» of the upcoming month, it is viewed as part of the upcoming month, and the vow applies to the new month.
